title: Embedded Configuration Equality
statement: Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $S$ be a type, and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Let $M$ be an $m$-work-tape Turing machine, let $\iota$ inject the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ indices, and let $c,d$ be configurations on input $x$ with respectively $m$ and $k$ work tapes. Suppose their states, input-head positions, and outputs agree; for each $i<m$, the contents and head position of tape $i$ in $c$ agree with those of tape $\iota(i)$ in $d$; and outside the image of $\iota$, the supplied tape contents and head positions agree with those in $d$. Then embedding $c$ into the $k$-tape configuration with the supplied contents and head positions, and with empty prefix output, gives exactly $d$.
hypotheses_covered: A type $S$ and Boolean input word $x$
An $m$-work-tape machine $M$ over Boolean symbols and states $S$
An embedding $\iota$ of the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
Configurations $c$ and $d$ on input $x$, with $m$ and $k$ work tapes respectively
Equality of the states, input-head positions, and outputs of $c$ and $d
Agreement of selected tape contents and head positions
Agreement of supplied and target tape contents and head positions outside the image of $\iota$
